description: This file defines a Repository interface for accessing products, cart, orders, and user authentication in a grocery ordering app. It also provides an in-memory implementation (InMemoryRepository) for demo purposes, managing data such as product catalog, shopping cart, orders, and user sessions. Additionally, it contains a singleton object for accessing the repository instance.

classes.name: InMemoryRepository
classes.description: A simple in-memory implementation of the Repository interface for demo purposes. Manages products, cart, orders, and user sessions.

methods.name: searchProducts
methods.description: Searches products by query string; returns all if query is empty.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns all products, optionally filtered by category.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart with specified quantity, aggregating if the product already exists.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates quantity of an existing cart item.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Places an order with current cart items; returns the order or null if cart is empty.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.description: Lists past orders, most recent first.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user or null.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Mock sign in function using email and password.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Mock sign up function, creating a new user.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates profile of the current user.

methods.name: cartTotal
methods.description: Computes total price of items in the cart.
